title: OpenCode Idle Steward Run v1
description: Schema for the last-run artifact written by the OpenCode Idle Lane Steward on every invocation.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this run artifact was generated.

steward_state.description: Steward state classification for this run.

dry_run.description: Whether this was a dry run (command constructed but not launched).

branch.description: Git branch at time of steward run.

head.description: Git HEAD commit SHA at time of steward run.

selected_task.description: The task selected for action, if any.

blocker_reasons.description: Reasons the selected task is blocked, if blocked state.

exit_code.description: Exit code from the OpenCode process. -1 if the binary was not found.

stderr_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the truncated stderr output.

stderr_truncated_bytes.description: Byte length of the stored truncated stderr.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of the OpenCode run in milliseconds.

stream_error.description: Error message if the streaming subsystem itself failed.

command_meta.description: Metadata about the constructed OpenCode command, if any.

audit_path.description: Path to unblock audit artifact, if audit_unblock_plan state.

error.description: Error message if the steward encountered a runtime error.

compiler_fallback_status.description: Whether the context capsule was available to the steward, whether the steward fell back to raw evidence reads, and why.
